set -eo pipefail
source /opt/ros/foxy/setup.bash
source /workspace/install/setup.bash
export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=196
export ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1

ros2 run scan_planner scan_planner_node --ros-args --params-file /config/planner.yaml -r body_pose:=/quad_0/body_pose -r sensor_pose:=/quad_0/lidar_pose -r cloud:=/quad_0/cloud > /logs/scan_planner_node.log 2>&1 &

python3 -m p2b_backend_ros.node --config /config/p2b_backend_ros.two_goal.json --run-id walk_v3_yaml --run-epoch-ns 1790396779629314493 --applied-snapshot /home/sun/vla_exec/2026-09-26_stair_video/walk_v3_yaml/artifacts/external_episode/current_command.json --finish-request /home/sun/vla_exec/2026-09-26_stair_video/walk_v3_yaml/artifacts/external_episode/finish_request.json --pct-port 47651 --http-port 8785 &

wait -n "$scan_pid" "$controller_pid" "$tracker_pid" "$health_pid" "$backend_pid"
